skills.name: Construct a series circuit with a parallel voltmeter
skills.description: Draw a circuit containing stated series components and a voltmeter connected in parallel across a specified component.

skills.name: Sketch a stationary wave at a specified time
skills.description: Sketch a stationary-wave profile at a stated time while retaining its nodes, wavelength and amplitude and reversing displacement after a half-integer number of periods.

skills.name: Derive series resistance using Kirchhoff's laws
skills.description: Use the loop potential-difference relation and Ohm's law to derive the combined resistance of resistors in series.

skills.name: Write nuclide notation
skills.description: Construct a nuclide symbol from an element, proton number and total nucleon number calculated from its protons and neutrons.

skills.name: Determine viscosity from a drag model
skills.description: Rearrange a supplied drag-force relationship to determine a fluid's viscosity from force, object size and speed using SI units.

skills.name: Locate the elastic limit on a force–extension graph
skills.description: Use stated elastic behaviour and a force–extension graph to locate the greatest extension from which a sample returns to its original length.

skills.name: Estimate work from a force–extension graph
skills.description: Estimate work done in deforming a sample by evaluating the area under its force–extension graph, including non-linear regions.

skills.name: Determine phase difference from a wave profile
skills.description: Use the fractional wavelength separating two points on a displacement–distance wave profile to determine their phase difference.

skills.name: Derive parallel resistance using Kirchhoff's laws
skills.description: Use current conservation and the shared potential difference across parallel branches to derive the reciprocal combined-resistance relationship.

skills.name: Distinguish alpha and beta energy spectra
skills.description: Use discrete alpha-particle energies and the continuous beta-particle energy range to identify or exclude each radiation type from a spectrum.

skills.name: Derive kinetic energy from work and motion
skills.description: Combine work done, Newton's second law and constant-acceleration motion to derive E_K = ½mv².

skills.name: Calculate average power from energy transfer
skills.description: Determine average output power by dividing the total energy transferred, including useful and resistive energy changes where applicable, by the elapsed time.

skills.name: Determine input current from power and efficiency
skills.description: Determine a device's electrical input current from its useful output power, efficiency and potential difference.

skills.name: Read wave amplitude from a displacement graph
skills.description: Determine a progressive wave's amplitude from the greatest displacement from its equilibrium line on a displacement–distance or displacement–time graph.

skills.name: Apply double-slit interference
skills.description: Use the double-slit fringe-spacing relationship to determine an unknown quantity or predict how fringe spacing changes with wavelength, slit separation or screen distance.

skills.name: Apply a Wheatstone-bridge null method
skills.description: Determine an unknown resistance by adjusting a bridge to zero galvanometer current and equating the ratios of the two resistor pairs.

skills.name: Define a fundamental particle
skills.description: State that a fundamental particle cannot be divided into smaller constituent particles.

skills.name: Calculate a nuclear charge-to-mass ratio
skills.description: Use proton number, nucleon number, elementary charge and the unified atomic mass unit to calculate or infer a nucleus's charge-to-mass ratio.
